handoffs.message: Implementation complete: models.py (GovernedLinkage, TraderFeedbackEvent, ExecutionTelemetryEvent), store.py (append-only FeedbackStore with query), 13 unit tests all passing. Smoke test, edit/rationale validation, draft-exclusion guard, duplicate idempotency, and query filters all verified.

Review requested changes: see .coordination/reviews/BP6-SVC-FB-001-review.md. Blocking issues: append-only guarantee is violated because stored events remain externally mutable after write, and created_at is not validated on ingest so malformed timestamps are accepted and later crash query(). Please snapshot/freeze events and validate RFC3339 timestamps with regression coverage.

Fixed both blocking review issues: (1) deep-copy at write/read boundaries enforces append-only guarantee — post-write mutation to caller's object no longer alters stored history; (2) _validate_rfc3339() in __post_init__ rejects malformed created_at at construction, not silently stored. 18 tests pass including 5 new regression tests covering mutation isolation and invalid timestamp rejection.

Review failed: services/feedback/models.py still accepts raw string enum fields without runtime coercion/validation, so schema can be bypassed and FeedbackStore.query(event_type=...) crashes with AttributeError on ev.event_type.value. Repro: construct TraderFeedbackEvent with event_type='approve', actor_role='operator', channel='web', write it, then query(event_type='approve'). Please validate/coerce enum-backed fields at construction and add regression coverage for raw-string ingestion across feedback/telemetry events.

Fixed enum coercion: _coerce_enum() added to all dataclass __post_init__ methods (TraderFeedbackEvent, ExecutionTelemetryEvent, GovernedLinkage, EditItem). Raw string fields like event_type='approve' are now coerced to enum instances at construction — FeedbackStore.query(event_type='approve') no longer crashes. 5 new regression tests; 23/23 pass.
Review approved. 23/23 unit tests pass, enum coercion fixed, preference events write/read verified. Owner to finalize.
